question: Can the selective DFS preserve potentially recovering discrepancy paths while avoiding a long synchronous equal-depth commitment to routes whose exact prefix deficit has persisted across three authored gaps?

relationship_to_maps.evidence: Prefix sign predicts risk but cannot safely kill a path: first crossing had two recoveries in 17 routes, and fresh three-checkpoint persistence had one recovery in nine target-observed routes. The latter nevertheless identified ten routes across nine runs and both sources, with 181143 measured frames after confirmation.
relationship_to_maps.categorical_change: Yield instead of kill. At the third adjacent non-positive checkpoint, stop only synchronous catch-up and put the exact live route behind the ordinary same-lane frontier. The suspended prefix resumes immediately; the yielded path remains available for later DFS exploration.
relationship_to_maps.anti_fit_boundary: The three-checkpoint signal was fixed before the fresh map. This arm changes work disposition, not its value, and receives wholly fresh score evidence.

implementation.retirement: The closed proper-discrepancy environment is removed from the parser; retained artifacts remain analyzable.
invariants: the production regret trigger and primary causal catch-up route are unchanged
a local route still requires positive starting prefix gain, nonzero remaining authored-gap advance, and the existing stable value-per-work selection
only a local discrepancy route can yield, only before the tournament target, and only after three non-positive checkpoints at adjacent authored gaps
the yielded SearchNode object is retained at low priority in its ordinary pass or fallback frontier rather than discarded
the tournament retains the suspended path; no yielded route is reported as completed or selected
deadline, execution ceiling, candidate generation, repair, terminal evaluation, register, and scoring logic remain unchanged
telemetry: exact yielded-route count and route-local nodes/frames through existing probe aggregates
route checkpoints proving the three-point sign, adjacency, pre-target position, and exact end counters
analyzer rejection of yielding under any legacy policy or of a yielded route reported as completed/selected

predeclared_screen.decision: Advance to a fresh two-seed all-catalog 750k breadth screen only if all cells retain validity, total target completed-track movement is positive, at least five of eight target seed blocks are positive, both target-source sums are positive, at least four target cells improve, no target cell loses 20 or more points, yielded routes occur in at least five target runs and both requested sources, and every analyzer trust check passes. Otherwise close without catalog or canonical evaluation.
predeclared_screen.next_if_passed: Use fresh actual seeds 136 and 137 over all 44 sources at 750k. Canonical V2 remains unauthorized until that catalog screen preserves validity, has positive total completed-track movement, and improvement is non-isolated.
predeclared_screen.non_claim: This focused arm measures one scheduling disposition at 750k. It cannot estimate a headline, authorize promotion, or establish multi-budget behavior.
